general.description: Zarmina is a harsh world, bathed on the dim light of its small Sun, known as Gliese 581. Harsh is its story, too. In the early times of the Policorporations, the planet was under the rule of a wicked CEO, who decide, to exploit the planet, to use nearly-slaves Humans. Worse, with the help of genengineer scientists, Zarminians miners offsprings where horribly mutated. Not only to adapt them to the infernous conditions of the planet, but to stole their Humanity. Nevertheless, the people of Zarmina, now named the Urks, hold on, and revolts after revolts, overthrown the policorpos' Tyrant. And before the Alliance was here, Zarmina was free ! Nowadays, Zarmina is a quiet world in the Alliance, Zarminians tends to go in outer space, leaving gradually their home planet.
general.bar: Prouds Zarminers chanting and talking about their act of bravery from their ancestors, gobbling pitcher of stone's cherry ale with merchants and passer-byes.
